_comment: Paper-1 params for VAAL (ADR 0015): identical to params_paper1.json plus an explicit strategy_args.VAAL block holding the defaults of dalmax.config.schema.VAALArgs (DeepAL+/original VAAL: 30 VAE/discriminator epochs per query over the joint labeled/unlabeled loader, latent 32, beta 1, adversary weight 1, 2 VAE steps and 1 discriminator step per batch, Adam lr 5e-4, images resized 128 -> 64 for the VAE). Spelled out so the per-query cost driver (epochs) is visible; params_paper1.json gives the same computation. The task model is trained exactly as for every other strategy. See .specs/adr/0015-deepalplus-strategies.md.
